blocks.content: Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Understood the value of managing dashboards with Git Sync and version control
- Learned how Git Sync works and the different sync states
- Reviewed prerequisites and known limitations
- Navigated to the Git Sync interface in Grafana Cloud
- Viewed synced dashboards and their sync status
- Managed dashboard synchronization between Grafana and Git

---

### Related paths

Consider taking the following journey after you complete this journey:

- [Work with dashboards using Git Sync](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/git-sync-dashboards/)
